---
applyTo: "ui/**"
---

Read the root `AGENTS.md`, `.ai/frontend.md` and `.ai/security.md`.
Trace changed API contracts into backend/domain rules as applicable.
For reviews follow `.ai/review.md`: built UI through nginx, real API and
database, Playwright, browser error checks, visual/accessibility inspection and
performance analysis. Mock-only tests do not meet the review requirement.
